summary: DarkPulse, Inc., a Delaware-incorporated prepackaged software issuer, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 6, 2026 it received notice from OTC Markets Group that its common stock would be removed from the OTCQB market and moved to the OTCID market, effective at market open on October 8, 2026, following expiration of the applicable grace period on October 7, 2026. The removal resulted from failure to satisfy the OTCQB minimum bid price requirement of $0.01 per share. Shares continue to quote as DPLS on OTCID. No advisor or board recommendation was disclosed; the move signals liquidity and visibility deterioration and is equivalent to a US exchange delisting to a lower tier. What to watch: pricing pressure, bid support, and any remediation plan to requalify for OTCQB.
